about: Measured-performance campaign, one Fishball7020 / PlutoSky board, 2026-09-18, v1.3 firmware build. 'runs' are tools/selftest/sdr_selftest.py --json outputs (--ssh --loopback --sweep-points 60 --sweep-start 70e6 --sweep-stop 6e9); the 'loop' block holds that run's per-loop keys with the channel prefix removed. Channel 0 = TX1A/RX1A on the case, channel 1 = TX2A/RX2A. path_loss_curve is loop gain in dB WITHOUT the pad added back. 'leak' is a fixed operating point (TX attenuation 35 dB, -6 dBFS tone, RX gain 46 dB manual, 30.72 MSPS): tone level at each frequency with the 50 dB stacked loop connected, and with the cable removed from the receive port (RX port open).
